description: C2: the Broken Warden, the giant kings' warden of the toll road, stands asleep in the breach of the old toll-keep above the King's Road. Hode the toll-keeper tells what he is and how he is beaten (his wall-shield guards him; his back and broken side; heavy blows break his guard; his bar's recovery; his walls and crumbling towers; his greaves); bring him down; Hode opens the old road and brings the masons to the keep (the Bastion set). He can be fought at any time: walking into his yard or striking him wakes him, and every stage completes on his death. Rewards: XP at each stage, gate-stone at the end.

stages.objective: Ask Hode the toll-keeper by the old road about the warden in the wall
Bring down the Broken Warden in the old toll-keep
Tell Hode the road is open
